ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Children's Science Museums. This course is a special exploration course intended to engage women undergraduates majoring in mathematics, science, and engineering curricula in museum work in the Champaign-Urbana area. Class meetings will take place at the WIMSE living/learning community, the Orpheum Children's Science Museum, as well as online. This course is restricted to students living in the WIMSE (Women in Mathematics, Science, and Engineering) living/learning community. Instructor permission required: Donna Michelle Hinn (hinn@uiuc.edu); Bertram (Chip) Bruce (chip@uiuc.edu).
